findings.title: Approved test policy watchdog freshness was not attainable in the measured isolated JDBC transport
findings.evidence: 40/40 fresh administrative heartbeat handoffs exceeded actual 100us and approved maximum 200us; minimum 2190us. This is a necessary-predicate experiment, not a full wrapper execution or proof of universal impossibility.
findings.consequence: Positive readiness/claim/E2E and dependent frozen parity, rollback, concurrency and recovery remain unqualified. No policy widening or forged PASS.
findings.next_action: Define and review a separate rehearsal-only fixture amendment using measured bounds, preserve preflight TTL 1000000/max2000000, and rerun positive readiness qualification before dependent gates.
